lines.t: We don't fuck, we rise through the scars
Kings been in battle, we're fined by the boss
House of order, not chaos, no fraud
Battle no queen, that won't bite a god
Set your house in order, purge that flame
Don't chase the pride, don't chase the fame
When a serpent whisper, expose his game
Real men walk clean, y'all sure they ain't
He was tempted in flesh and never gave in
That's the motto divine within
World hate truth, cause truth bring pain
But pain purified us, our king's reign
Adam fell when he listened to some
Chose flesh over order and it cost the cross
But Abraham stood, knife in hand
Faith over feeling, obey the command
Man, Joseph fled when lust came near
In the pagan cell, but his conscience clear
Daniel prayed when death was law
Lions bowed down, that's real law
These ain't tales, that's bloodline proof
Men of God, stay tight to the truth
Built from humility, should've bought flame
They ain't moved by looks, they ain't moved by his name
Yeah, they call it toxic, we call it divine
Real strength don't bend, it's standing line
World full of Dezimels wearing disguise
Preach power, but they dead inside
Set your house in order, build that wall
Guard your soul, don't lose it all
She ain't walking, holy, then let her crawl
Cause peace ain't found in lust at all
See that pride
Burning from sight
The sun's still pure
And the devil's spiked
Real men bleed
For they lose what's right
But the scars of faith
In the chains of night
Samson strong
But blind in bed
Lost his crown
And lost his head
Solomon wise
To the women deceived
Split the throne
For the lie he believed
They have gave
Rulership to his bride
Fear the sharp tongue
So he stepped aside
Modern men still play that part
Talk like kings
But their hearts ain't smart
They serve themselves
Let rebellion win
Praising the flesh
While they drown in sin
But Yahushua walked
Where the serpent creaked
40 nights, no sleep, no cheat, no weep
Faced every lust that devils bring
And still wore the crown of a sinless king
He ain't foe when the cross got near
Drink, breath, dry, no trace of fear
That's the mode, the mission, the code
Walk that fire, bear that load
Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey
Bear that load
Set your house in order, draw your blade
The war incarnate, it's true display
These streets need prophets, now sons of shape
Men of Yah, born, not made
Stop chasing crowns from godless queens
They promise heaven, but they eat your dreams
Fear the Lord, let your spirit clean
Walk like him, I'm bent unseen
So when the world mock, let them talk loud
We building silence, heaven proud
Masculine hearts, no counterfeit
The volume spoke, this the grit
Tempted for pure, scar, yeah, ho, ho, ho, ho
We ain't playing for lust, we war for souls
Rise up, men, take y'all's command
Man, man, man, man
Set your house and take your stand
